name: cua
description: Computer use for Claude Code on macOS (Apple silicon) and Linux (X11) through OpenAI's computer-use runtime: a stdio MCP server running the pinned runtime that `cua install` places under CUA_HOME; the cua-remote skill, to set up or drive another computer through `cua agent` and a relay; and /secret KEY (function hooks, under CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1), a secret stored in ~/.config/claude-secrets that the model sees only by its key.
